dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Observed five prominent 'O' shaped rings along the mid-dorsal region; each features a sharp transition from the dark exterior coat to a high-intensity tan perimeter, which then transitions back into a dark circular core. The perimeters are irregular with variable pixel width.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of localized, solid tan pixel clusters observed along the lower ventral-lateral edge; these clusters exhibit high core pixel concentration and lack an internal light-to-dark gradient. A large amorphous high-intensity region is visible at the anterior-dorsal neck area.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the five primary dorsal-lateral annuli form an asymmetrical pentagonal geometry. The spatial relationship shows a tighter clustering of the three anterior-most centroids compared to the elongated distance between the anterior and posterior-most centroids.
